headline: Foreign Investors Net Sell NT$62.6 Billion; Memory Maker Powerchip (6770) Sees Largest Sell-Off at 72,000 Lots; Financial Stock CTBC Holding (2891) Leads Buying
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at 45,511.49 points, down 351.03 points, as foreign investors net sold NT$62,699 million. Memory maker Powerchip saw the largest foreign net sell-off, while CTBC Holding drew net buying.
why: Taiwan's benchmark index is heavily weighted toward semiconductors, so foreign flows into and out of chip names shape its direction. Foreign investors are a major source of liquidity in the market.
why_moved: Foreign investors net sold NT$62.7 billion, with Powerchip the largest individual seller. Heavy foreign selling in index heavyweights pushed the market lower.
